## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (the tests and `node tools/check.js`).
- [ ] If I changed a page, style, script or voice clip, I ran `node tools/make-offline.js`.
- [ ] If anything on screen changed, I played it through at 1280x614 and 800x1094 (and 1280x800, 800x1280), with no console errors, and added screenshots.
- [ ] It follows the rules for what children see and hear in CONTRIBUTING.md (real chess words, never left or right, no fail states, no locked levels).
- [ ] New or changed voice lines are in `js/lessons.js` and `docs/VOICE-SCRIPT.md`, in every language.
- [ ] The documentation is updated where behaviour changed (README, docs/DESIGN.md, help.html, PRIVACY.md, SECURITY.md).
- [ ] I wrote this myself, or have the right to contribute it, and I agree to the contribution terms in CONTRIBUTING.md.
